mapper.select: select count(1) from lab_notification where receiver_id = #{userId} and delivery_status = 'SENT' and read_at is null

select d.status as code, count(1) as value from lab_device d join lab_laboratory l on l.id = d.laboratory_id and l.del_flag = '0' where d.del_flag = '0'
group by d.status order by d.status
